title: Read the bid, ask and spread
summary: Find the [[bid]] and [[ask]] for EUR/USD in the Quotes tab and work out the [[spread]] in [[pip|pips]].

steps.text: Open MetaTrader and go to the Quotes tab.
Find EUR/USD in the list. Each symbol shows two prices.
The lower price is the bid: where you can sell. The higher price is the ask: where you can buy.
Write both prices down at the same moment.
Subtract the bid from the ask. Divide by 0.0001 to get the spread in pips.
Do the same for USD/JPY, but divide by 0.01, because yen pairs use a different pip size.

afterQuestions.prompt: You see EUR/USD at 1.08452 and 1.08467. What is the spread?

options.explanation: No: 0.00015 is 15 pipettes, which is 1.5 pips.

afterQuestions.prompt: Which of the two prices you saw would you get if you bought at market?

options.explanation: No: the bid is where you sell.
Right: buys fill at the ask.
